{{Top|leg}}
The '''Lenushaa gang''' was a criminal organization led by [[Wonn Ionstrike/Legends|Wonn Ionstrike]]. It had sixty-three members, ranging from [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], and operated two [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]], the ''[[Bountiful Hunter]]'' and the ''[[Iviitz]]''.
